proof_steps.claim: Phi_N=Phi_Nprime∘sigma on a nonempty source-open regular set U; N,Nprime are binary standard semi-directed strongly tree-child level-2 networks on the same labels.
Every target bridge split is a source bridge split: Cut(Nprime) subset Cut(N).
proof_steps.reason: A target-cut 5x5 flattening minor vanishes after composition with sigma on U. If the split were a source noncut, isotropic-JC generic recovery gives a nonzero source polynomial, which cannot vanish on U.

proof_steps.claim: Assume for contradiction that S=A|B is a bridge split of N and is not a bridge split of Nprime.
Both A and B contain at least two labels.
proof_steps.reason: A singleton side is the pendant leaf bridge in every standard network, so it cannot be lost.

proof_steps.claim: Color the target reduced bridge tree by A/B. The crossing-quartet tree dichotomy gives either a target bridge R with both colors on both sides, or a unique central component v with at least two monochromatic incident branches of each color.

proof_steps.reason: Its split R has all four intersections with S nonempty, so R crosses S. D1 makes R a source bridge split, while bridge splits of one reduced tree are compatible; this contradicts that S is a source bridge split.

proof_steps.claim: The target witness is one central active component v; every selected-leaf-free serial path or two-boundary side blob on its four arms compresses to an effective K3P edge.

Strong-tree-child primitive-core support and noncut word compression select two actual A labels and two actual B labels whose one-active restriction is a wrong-split direction in the complete 204-direction universe.
proof_steps.reason: Minimum repair and path-sink roles are retained as zero-character completion ports. Switching compression has zero survivors; hence some switching fails the color split and a four-leaf tree witness exists.

proof_steps.claim: Marginalizing the containment identity to the four selected labels gives identical source and target quartet tensors pointwise on U.
proof_steps.reason: Fourier marginalization sets omitted characters to zero; it is a direct linear marginal of the original identity and needs no target-open parameter image.

proof_steps.claim: The compressed target quartet is evaluated at a strict physical D3,+ point.
proof_steps.reason: Nonempty serial edge classes compose by strictly positive Z2xZ2 convolution; a two-boundary side blob is a positive convex mixture of its strict displayed-path K3P matrices; inheritances are retained, complemented, or summed out.

proof_steps.claim: The source quartet flattening on the selected 2|2 split has rank at most four at every point of U.
proof_steps.reason: The source bridge S survives the two-label-per-side restriction and the four K3P character blocks factor as rank-one outer products.

proof_steps.claim: The target quartet flattening on that split has rank greater than four at every strict physical target point.
proof_steps.reason: All 204 normalized one-active wrong-split directions have pointwise exact certificates. Effective edge products remain strict D3+; inherited probabilities are retained, complemented, or disappear.

proof_steps.claim: Contradiction: the same quartet tensor cannot have flattening rank both at most four and greater than four.
Cut(N)=Cut(Nprime) under source-relative regular full-dimensional containment in the stated strong class.

scope.domain: strict principal K3P domain D3,+ with inheritance probabilities in (0,1)
scope.network_class: binary standard semi-directed strongly tree-child level-2
scope.relation: source-relative regular full-dimensional analytic containment N preceq Nprime

strict_physical_marginal.Fourier_marginal_statement: Omitted leaf characters are set to zero, so the quartet flattening is the corresponding Fourier submatrix.
strict_physical_marginal.inheritance_statement: Each inheritance is retained as lambda, complemented to 1-lambda, or summed out; retained values remain in (0,1).
strict_physical_marginal.serial_convolution_statement: A serial product of strict D3,+ K3P matrices is strict D3,+: in probability coordinates it is convolution of two strictly positive Z2xZ2 distributions, and its spectra are coordinatewise products in (0,1).
strict_physical_marginal.two_terminal_blob_mixture_statement: A selected-leaf-free two-boundary side blob is a convex mixture, with positive switching weights summing to one, of strict K3P path matrices. Convex mixture preserves strict positivity of all inverse-Fourier probabilities and keeps each nontrivial spectrum in (0,1).

trivial_split_handling: A singleton side is the pendant leaf bridge in every standard network; therefore a source split absent from the target is automatically nontrivial with at least two labels on each side.

two_active_exclusion.contradiction: S and R would be incompatible bridge splits of the same source reduced bridge tree
two_active_exclusion.directional_step: R in Cut(Nprime) implies R in Cut(N)
two_active_exclusion.incompatibility_criterion: two splits are compatible iff at least one of the four intersections is empty
